curriculum.subject: English Language Activities
curriculum.outcomeText: read words featuring the letters I to P for fluency

interactions.prompt: Tap the letter that begins the word lion.
interactions.retryHint: Say lion slowly and listen to its first sound.

interactions.prompt: Match each picture word to its first letter.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap a word, then its first letter.
interactions.feedback: Great matching! I starts ink, J starts jug, and K starts kite.
interactions.retryHint: Say each word and listen to the beginning sound.
Look for the word with the /m/ sound.

interactions.prompt: Sort the words by their first letter.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap a word, then its letter group.
interactions.feedback: Super sorting! You grouped every L and O word.
interactions.retryHint: Listen to the first sound in each word.

interactions.prompt: Put these words in letter order from I to P.
interactions.feedback: Well ordered! The first letters move from I towards P.
interactions.retryHint: Compare the first letter of every word.

interactions.prompt: Which row can you read from I to P without repeating a first letter?
choices: ink, jug, kite, lion, moon, nest, orange, pen
ink, ink, kite, lion, moon, nest, orange, pen
jug, ink, kite, moon, lion, nest, pen, orange
interactions.answer: ink, jug, kite, lion, moon, nest, orange, pen
interactions.feedback: Mission complete! You read words beginning with I through P in order.
interactions.retryHint: Check that the first letters are I, J, K, L, M, N, O, P.
